@@ -278,6 +288,59 @@ class filter) at 0.4-0.7 s per frame in 2.3 GB of video memory. It needs the
 image built from `docker/Dockerfile.dualmap` (DualMap source at a pinned commit plus its
 two extra weights) and is selected per deployment:
 
+Native and Jetson Docker builds also prepare DualMap when
+`SCENE_PERCEPTION_BACKEND=dualmap` is set. The build verifies the pinned source
+archive and applies `docker/dualmap-inference.patch`. The patch injects Scene's
+shared inference implementation and uses NumPy for association and point-cloud
+projection; DualMap keeps its local/global map and object lifecycle rules.
+Duplicate-mask filtering ranks near-equal areas by detection confidence, then
+class ID. The tolerance is one pixel or 0.1% of the larger mask, whichever is
+greater; larger area differences retain DualMap's configured size preference.
+Native builds install the same pinned Rerun SDK and browser assets as Docker.
+Assets are cached by SDK version inside the prepared Python environment; startup
+selects that directory and its `rerun` executable automatically.
+
+Point-cloud subsampling uses frame-indexed pixel ranks so a small mask-boundary
+change does not reshuffle the whole sample. RGB remains the map/CLIP format;
+detector and segmenter calls convert to their BGR input format.
+
+Local CLIP checkpoints reuse published preprocessing when the model's pretrained
+variants agree. This preserves MobileCLIP-S2's zero mean, unit standard deviation
+and bilinear resize. Torch image encoding disables cuDNN TF32 within the call and
+restores the previous setting. ONNX export expands supported fused visual
+attention after checking it against the original model; TensorRT preparation
+checks each reference embedding, including black and white image inputs.
+
+Torch retains Ultralytics' default 640 rectangular preprocessing. TensorRT uses
+672 square inputs, so switching backends can change detections. Numerical backend
+comparisons must use the same input preprocessing.
+
+Set both `SCENE_PERCEPTION_BACKEND=dualmap` and `SCENE_CG_INFERENCE=tensorrt`
+before building and starting. Torch and TensorRT support Lite and Full,
+FastSAM, unknown segments, local/global mapping and the optional
+`SCENE_EXPORT_CG_PICKLE` Replica export. DualMap uses MobileSAM and MobileCLIP-S2
+for both recognition profiles. Annotate reuses the Lite build artifacts and runs
+without perception. Torch remains the default.
+
+DualMap builds prepare FastSAM and a separate ViT-B-32 text graph for Replica's
+feature space. FastSAM is loaded when `use_fastsam` is enabled (by default this
+follows `keep_unknown`); the Replica encoder is loaded when exporting.
+FastSAM retains 1024-pixel, stride-aligned rectangular preprocessing through a
+dynamic-shape TensorRT engine. Unknown segments are also retained when YOLO
+finds no named objects. Mask overlap filtering uses NumPy with one mask-sized
+boolean workspace.
+
+`SCENE_DUALMAP_EXPORT_CLIP` can select an existing local ViT-B-32 checkpoint for
+Replica export. Rebuild after changing it. Export errors propagate to the caller;
+a failed encoder cannot produce zero feature vectors.
+
+With the DualMap and pytest dependencies installed, run the prepared-source
+filter regressions from `system/scene`:
+
+```sh
+SCENE_DUALMAP_ROOT="$(python3 scripts/prepare_dualmap.py)" python3 -m pytest tests/test_dualmap_filter.py
+```
+

+def load_perception(classes, *, profile="lite", backend="concept_graphs", yolo_path=None,
+                    sam_path=None, clip_model=None, clip_pretrained=None, device=None, use_fastsam=False):
+    """Load the selected inference implementation with mapper-specific model defaults."""
+    import os
+    from pathlib import Path
+    from ..inference_config import (
+        engine_cache_dir, inference_backend, model_config, prepared_models_dir,
+        validate_tensorrt_config,
+    )
+
+    models = model_config(profile, backend=backend)
+    yolo = yolo_path or models["yolo"]
+    clip_model = clip_model or models["clip_model"]
+    if inference_backend() == "torch":
+        from .perception_torch import TorchPerception
+
+        return TorchPerception(classes, yolo, sam_path or models["sam"], clip_model,
+                               clip_pretrained or models["clip_pretrained"], device=device,
+                               fastsam_path=models["fastsam"] if use_fastsam else None)
+    validate_tensorrt_config(profile=profile, backend=backend)
+    from .perception_engines import load_engines
+
+    directory = prepared_models_dir(os.environ.get("SCENE_ONNX_DIR") or str(Path(yolo).parent / "onnx"))
+    return load_engines(classes, models_dir=directory,
+                        cache_dir=str(engine_cache_dir(directory)), profile=profile,
+                        clip_model=clip_model, use_fastsam=use_fastsam)
+
+
+def create_clip_model(model_name, pretrained):
+    from pathlib import Path
+    import open_clip
+
+    options = {}
+    if pretrained and Path(pretrained).is_file():
+        # Local weights bypass tag metadata. Only reuse unambiguous published transforms.
+        transforms = []
+        for tag in open_clip.list_pretrained_tags_by_model(model_name):
+            config = open_clip.get_pretrained_cfg(model_name, tag)
+            transforms.append({f"image_{key}": config[key]
+                               for key in ("mean", "std", "interpolation", "resize_mode")
+                               if config.get(key) is not None})
+        if transforms and all(value == transforms[0] for value in transforms):
+            options = transforms[0]
+    model, train_transform, transform = open_clip.create_model_and_transforms(
+        model_name, pretrained=pretrained, precision="fp32", **options,
+    )
+    model.eval()
+    if any(callable(getattr(module, "reparameterize", None)) for module in model.modules()):
+        from timm.utils import reparameterize_model
+
+        model = reparameterize_model(model)
+    return model.eval(), train_transform, transform

+def checksum(path):
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def verify(root):
+    root = Path(root)
+    saved = json.loads((root / ".rbnx-inference.json").read_text())
+    if (saved["commit"] != COMMIT or saved["patch"] != checksum(PATCH)
+            or any(checksum(root / name) != digest for name, digest in saved["files"].items())
+            or set(saved["files"]) != set(ORIGINAL)):
+        raise RuntimeError("Prepared DualMap source changed; rebuild the selected environment")
+
+
+def fetch_archive(cache):
+    cache.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    archive = cache / f"{COMMIT}.tar.gz"
+    if archive.is_file() and checksum(archive) == ARCHIVE_SHA256:
+        return archive
+    official = f"https://codeload.github.com/Eku127/DualMap/tar.gz/{COMMIT}"
+    github = f"https://github.com/Eku127/DualMap/archive/{COMMIT}.tar.gz"
+    mirror = os.environ.get("RBNX_GH_MIRROR", "").rstrip("/")
+    urls = [f"{mirror}/{github}", official] if mirror else [official]
+    pending = archive.with_suffix(".part")
+    for url in urls:
+        try:
+            subprocess.run(["curl", "-fL", "--connect-timeout", "15", "--max-time", "180",
+                            "--retry", "1", "--speed-time", "30", "--speed-limit", "4096",
+                            "-o", str(pending), url], check=True, timeout=400)
+            if checksum(pending) != ARCHIVE_SHA256:
+                raise ValueError("DualMap source archive checksum mismatch")
+            pending.replace(archive)
+            return archive
+        except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
+            print(f"[scene/dualmap] {type(error).__name__}; trying next source", flush=True)
+        finally:
+            pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+    raise RuntimeError("Could not download the verified DualMap source")
+
+
+def extract(archive, destination):
+    with tarfile.open(archive, "r:gz") as bundle:
+        for member in bundle:
+            parts = Path(member.name).parts
+            if not parts or parts[0] != f"DualMap-{COMMIT}":
+                raise ValueError("Unexpected DualMap archive prefix")
+            relative = Path(*parts[1:])
+            if not relative.parts or relative.parts[0] not in ("utils", "config", "LICENSE"):
+                continue
+            target = destination / relative
+            if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(destination.resolve()):
+                raise ValueError("Unsafe DualMap archive path")
+            if member.isdir():
+                continue
+            if not member.isfile():
+                raise ValueError("DualMap source must contain only regular files")
+            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            with bundle.extractfile(member) as source, target.open("wb") as output:
+                shutil.copyfileobj(source, output)
+
+
+def prepare(destination=None):
+    cache = PKG / "rbnx-build/dualmap"
+    key = checksum(PATCH)
+    destination = Path(destination) if destination else cache / key
+    if destination.exists():
+        verify(destination)
+        return destination
+    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    archive = fetch_archive(cache)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=".dualmap-", dir=destination.parent) as temporary:
+        staged = Path(temporary) / "source"
+        staged.mkdir()
+        extract(archive, staged)
+        if any(checksum(staged / name) != digest for name, digest in ORIGINAL.items()):
+            raise RuntimeError("DualMap source differs from the pinned version")
+        subprocess.run(["git", "apply", "--check", str(PATCH)], cwd=staged, check=True, timeout=30)
+        subprocess.run(["git", "apply", str(PATCH)], cwd=staged, check=True, timeout=30)
+        for name in ORIGINAL:
+            compile((staged / name).read_bytes(), str(staged / name), "exec")
+        saved = dict(commit=COMMIT, patch=key,
+                     files={name: checksum(staged / name) for name in ORIGINAL})
+        (staged / ".rbnx-inference.json").write_text(json.dumps(saved, indent=2) + "\n")
+        verify(staged)
+        staged.rename(destination)
+    return destination
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(prepare(args.root))

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MulanPSL-2.0
+# Install the web assets matching Scene's pinned Rerun SDK.
+set -euo pipefail
+PKG="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
+VERSION="$(sed -n 's/^rerun-sdk==//p' "$PKG/docker/requirements/scene-viewer.txt")"
+DEST="${1:?viewer asset destination required}/$VERSION"
+if [[ -s "$DEST/index.js" && -s "$DEST/re_viewer.js" && -s "$DEST/re_viewer_bg.wasm" ]]; then
+    exit 0
+fi
+mkdir -p "$(dirname "$DEST")"
+STAGING="$(mktemp -d "$(dirname "$DEST")/.viewer.XXXXXX")"
+trap 'rm -rf "$STAGING"' EXIT
+curl -fSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 \
+    "${NPM_REGISTRY:-https://registry.npmmirror.com}/@rerun-io/web-viewer/-/web-viewer-${VERSION}.tgz" \
+    -o "$STAGING/viewer.tgz"
+mkdir "$STAGING/assets"
+tar xzf "$STAGING/viewer.tgz" -C "$STAGING/assets" --strip-components=1 \
+    package/index.js package/re_viewer.js package/re_viewer_bg.wasm
+for name in index.js re_viewer.js re_viewer_bg.wasm; do
+    [[ -f "$STAGING/assets/$name" && ! -L "$STAGING/assets/$name" && -s "$STAGING/assets/$name" ]]
+done
+rm -rf "$DEST"
+mv "$STAGING/assets" "$DEST"

+    import builtins

+    import supervision as sv
+    module = importlib.import_module(filter_type.__module__)
+    rng = np.random.default_rng(9)
+    first = rng.random((7, 24, 31)) > .4
+    current = rng.random((3, 24, 31)) > .4
+    first[0] = current[0]
+    first[1] = False
+    first[-1, :, :15] = False
+    a, b = torch.from_numpy(first).flatten(1).float(), torch.from_numpy(current).flatten(1).float()
+    intersection = a @ b.T
+    aa, bb = a.sum(1)[:, None], b.sum(1)[None]
+    keep = ~((intersection / (aa + bb - intersection).clamp_min(1e-7) > .5)
+             | (intersection / aa.clamp_min(1e-7) > .6)
+             | (intersection / bb.clamp_min(1e-7) > .6)).any(1).numpy()
+    make = lambda masks: sv.Detections(xyxy=np.zeros((len(masks), 4), np.float32),
+                                      confidence=np.arange(len(masks), dtype=np.float32),
+                                      class_id=np.zeros(len(masks), int), mask=masks)
+    source = make(first)
+    original = builtins.__import__
+    def no_torch(name, *args, **kwargs):
+        if name.split('.')[0] == 'torch':
+            raise AssertionError('overlap filtering must not import Torch')
+        return original(name, *args, **kwargs)

+    result = detector.filter_fs_detections_by_curr(source, make(current))

+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(result.confidence, source.confidence[keep])

+    ih, iw = inputs.shape[1:]

+    prediction = np.concatenate([boxes.T, np.linspace(.9, .6, 56)[None], rng.normal(size=(4, 56))]).astype(np.float32)[None]
+    proto = rng.normal(size=(1, 4, ih // 4, iw // 4)).astype(np.float32)
+    pred = non_max_suppression(torch.from_numpy(prediction.copy()), .25, .9, nc=1)[0]
+    pred[:, :4] = ops.scale_boxes((ih, iw), pred[:, :4], shape)
+    expected_masks = ops.process_mask_native(torch.from_numpy(proto[0]), pred[:, 6:], pred[:, :4], shape).numpy().astype(bool)

+    np.testing.assert_allclose(got, pred[:, :6].numpy(), atol=1e-4)
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(masks, expected_masks)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MulanPSL-2.0
+"""Pinned source preparation preserves old generations and rejects changed code."""
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import io
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import tarfile
+
+import pytest
+
+
+def module():
+    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts/prepare_dualmap.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("prepare_dualmap", source)
+    result = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(result)
+    return result
+
+
+def setup_source(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    prepare = module()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prepare, "PKG", tmp_path)
+    original = b"value = 1\n"
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prepare, "ORIGINAL", {"utils/object_detector.py": hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()})
+    patch = tmp_path / "change.patch"
+    patch.write_text("--- a/utils/object_detector.py\n+++ b/utils/object_detector.py\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-value = 1\n+value = 2\n")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prepare, "PATCH", patch)
+    archive = tmp_path / "rbnx-build/dualmap" / f"{prepare.COMMIT}.tar.gz"
+    archive.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    with tarfile.open(archive, "w:gz") as bundle:
+        member = tarfile.TarInfo(f"DualMap-{prepare.COMMIT}/utils/object_detector.py")
+        member.size = len(original)
+        bundle.addfile(member, io.BytesIO(original))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prepare, "ARCHIVE_SHA256", prepare.checksum(archive))
+    return prepare
+
+
+def test_cached_source_is_patched_and_verified_before_reuse(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    prepare = setup_source(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    source = prepare.prepare()
+    assert (source / "utils/object_detector.py").read_text() == "value = 2\n"
+    assert prepare.prepare() == source
+    (source / "utils/object_detector.py").write_text("value = 3\n")
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="changed"):
+        prepare.prepare()
+
+
+def test_failed_patch_does_not_change_the_previous_source(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    prepare = setup_source(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    source = prepare.prepare()
+    prepare.PATCH.write_text("--- a/utils/object_detector.py\n+++ b/utils/object_detector.py\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-value = 9\n+value = 3\n")
+    with pytest.raises(subprocess.CalledProcessError):
+        prepare.prepare()
+    assert (source / "utils/object_detector.py").read_text() == "value = 2\n"
+    assert not list(source.parent.glob(".dualmap-*"))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name,link", [("utils/../../escape.py", False), ("utils/link.py", True)])
+def test_source_archive_rejects_paths_and_links(tmp_path, name, link):
+    prepare = module()
+    archive = tmp_path / "unsafe.tar.gz"
+    with tarfile.open(archive, "w:gz") as bundle:
+        member = tarfile.TarInfo(f"DualMap-{prepare.COMMIT}/{name}")
+        if link:
+            member.type, member.linkname = tarfile.SYMTYPE, "/etc/passwd"
+        bundle.addfile(member)
+    destination = tmp_path / "source"
+    destination.mkdir()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        prepare.extract(archive, destination)
+    assert not (tmp_path / "escape.py").exists()
+
+
+def test_bad_mirror_archive_falls_back_to_the_verified_origin(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    prepare = module()
+    expected = b"verified archive"
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prepare, "ARCHIVE_SHA256", hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest())
+    monkeypatch.setenv("RBNX_GH_MIRROR", "https://example.invalid")
+    sources = []
+
+    def download(command, **kwargs):
+        sources.append(command[-1])
+        Path(command[command.index("-o") + 1]).write_bytes(b"corrupt" if len(sources) == 1 else expected)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prepare.subprocess, "run", download)
+    archive = prepare.fetch_archive(tmp_path)
+    assert archive.read_bytes() == expected
+    assert len(sources) == 2 and sources[1].startswith("https://codeload.github.com/")

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MulanPSL-2.0
+"""Native viewer assets are cached only after a complete extraction."""
+import io
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import tarfile
+
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('complete', [True, False])
+def test_viewer_assets_publish_and_cache(tmp_path, complete):
+    package = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+    version = next(line.split('==')[1] for line in
+                   (package / 'docker/requirements/scene-viewer.txt').read_text().splitlines()
+                   if line.startswith('rerun-sdk=='))
+    archive = tmp_path / 'registry/@rerun-io/web-viewer/-' / f'web-viewer-{version}.tgz'
+    archive.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    names = ['index.js', 're_viewer.js', 're_viewer_bg.wasm']
+    with tarfile.open(archive, 'w:gz') as stream:
+        for name in names if complete else names[:2]:
+            content = b'asset'
+            member = tarfile.TarInfo('package/' + name)
+            member.size = len(content)
+            stream.addfile(member, io.BytesIO(content))
+    env = dict(os.environ, NPM_REGISTRY=(tmp_path / 'registry').as_uri())
+    destination = tmp_path / 'assets'
+    command = ['bash', str(package / 'scripts/prepare_viewer.sh'), str(destination)]
+    result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, capture_output=True)
+    assert (result.returncode == 0) == complete
+    assert not list(destination.glob('.viewer.*'))
+    if complete:
+        assert all((destination / version / name).read_bytes() == b'asset' for name in names)
+        archive.unlink()
+        subprocess.run(command, env=env, capture_output=True, check=True)
+    else:
+        assert not (destination / version).exists()
